description: Angers Stationnement is a dataset listed in Angers Loire Métropole - Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Angers Loire Métropole. Lieux de stationnement en parcs à usage public à Angers. Ce jeu de données respecte le schéma des lieux de stationnement de la Base Consolidé des Données de stationnement conformément au cadre légal. Ce jeu de données est construit pour une première partie en respect du schéma des lieux de stationnement Description du schéma. Coverage: Angers Loire Métropole. The portal files it under Stationnement. Its keywords are stationnement, Parking. The portal shows 18 records. The portal shows 2026-02-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-angers-fr-portal.
